Image Pixelator

Pixelate any photo with an adjustable block size and download the result.

Image Pixelator

Pixelate photos with an adjustable block size — great for anonymizing faces or plates.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose an image file from your device.
  2. Drag the block-size slider (4–64 px) to set the pixel size.
  3. Preview the pixelated result live.
  4. Click "Download PNG" to save it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the pixelation work?

The image is drawn tiny (one pixel per block) and then scaled back up with smoothing disabled, which produces the classic mosaic pixelation effect.

Can I use this to anonymize faces?

Yes — larger blocks mean bigger pixels and stronger anonymization, which is handy for hiding faces or license plates.

Is my image uploaded anywhere?

No. Your image is processed locally in your browser and never uploaded anywhere.
